description: ANThology's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ContainerHub's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the other consumers.

WHAT THIS REPO GETS IS DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS, and it is worth stating so nobody looks for the wrong thing. ANThology has NO ContainerHub submodule -- its workflows check the tooling out in CI -- so the preset's git-submodules manager, which is the headline everywhere else, has no gitlink to watch here. What it does buy: helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests over the third-party actions this repo references by tag, and the preset rule that deliberately leaves the Kataglyphis/ContainerHub composite actions at @main for the upstream-first change flow.

That second rule matters here more than in any other repo: dart.yml checks ContainerHub out at a floating `ref: main` rather than a pin, so the actions and the tooling must be allowed to move together.
.github/dependabot.yml is deliberately still present; it covers the pub ecosystem. The hand-over is a separate decision.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from ContainerHub's DEFAULT BRANCH. This file stays inert until the Renovate GitHub App is installed on this repository -- no bot has ever authored a commit here. Until then the local CLI reads it: see docs/dependency-updates.md in ContainerHub.
